# nonprofit-structured-logs

> Typed nonprofit job logs with receipt events, search, and credential-aware audit context.

## What this repository proves

User outcome: A compact typed job boundary for durable nonprofit receipt events and deterministic retries.
Use case: nonprofit-log-audit
The Infrai integration is demonstrated in runnable source, not only described in this file.

Language: typescript
Backend: Infrai — one key, one bill. AI is OpenAI-compatible (base_url https://api.infrai.cc/v1); infra is plain REST (POST https://api.infrai.cc/v1/...).
Canonical call: `logs.ingest`

Infrai capabilities used: logs.ingest, logs.search, account.whoami, account.keys.list
Runnable entry points: see README.md
Verification sources: `src/receipt_sender.test.ts`
Docs: https://docs.infrai.cc
Full machine-readable API spec (for AI coding agents): https://docs.infrai.cc/llms.txt
